title: 10.1 Lines and Segments That Intersect Circles

icans: I can name the special segments and lines of a circle.
I can use the fact that a tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of tangency.
I can use the fact that two tangent segments from the same point are congruent.

vocab: a segment whose ____________ are on a circle
a line that _____________ a circle in two points
a line in the plane of a circle that _____________ the circle in exactly one point
the point where a tangent line _____________ the circle
